faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about the platform

whatIsPlatform.q: What is QMED and what is this platform for?
whatIsPlatform.a: QMED is a digital platform for productivity management and employee activity monitoring. It allows you to track work sessions, generate reports, manage teams and projects, and get AI-powered productivity analytics.

howToRegister.q: How do I register on the platform?
howToRegister.a: Go to the registration page, enter your full name, email and password (minimum 8 characters, uppercase and lowercase letter, digit). After registration, you can create an organization or join an existing one.

howToJoinOrg.q: How do I join an organization?
howToJoinOrg.a: On the dashboard, enter the organization code provided by your administrator and click "Join". Your request will be sent to the administrator for approval. Once approved, you'll have access to all organization features.

howToCreateOrg.q: How do I create my own organization?
howToCreateOrg.a: On the dashboard, click "Create Organization" and enter a name. After creation, you'll become the administrator and receive a unique code to invite employees.

whatIsActivity.a: The activity module allows you to record employee work sessions. Each session records the start and end time, device, and operating system. This helps with work time accounting.

howToStartSession.q: How do I start a work session?
howToStartSession.a: Go to the "Activity" page, enter your device name and operating system, then click "Start Session". To finish, click "Stop Session". All your sessions are saved in history.

canManagerSeeActivity.q: Can my manager see my activity?
canManagerSeeActivity.a: Yes, organization administrators can see sessions of all members in the "Organization Sessions" tab. Regular employees can only see their own sessions.

whatReportsAvailable.q: What reports are available on the platform?
whatReportsAvailable.a: The platform provides: Organization and project KPIs, session and user metrics, AI productivity analytics, and the ability to export reports in various formats.

howToExportReport.q: How do I export a report?
howToExportReport.a: On the "Reports" page, go to the "Exports" tab, select the report type, period and format (PDF, CSV, JSON), then click "Create". The file will appear in the export history.

whatIsAiScore.q: What is the AI productivity score?
whatIsAiScore.a: AI analytics uses activity data to automatically calculate a productivity score. The system analyzes work patterns, considers the employee's role, and provides recommendations for improving efficiency.

howToChangePassword.q: How do I change my password?
howToChangePassword.a: Go to "Settings" and use the security section. If you forgot your current password, use the "Forgot password?" function on the login page.

howToEnable2fa.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
howToEnable2fa.a: Go to "Settings" → "Security" and click "Enable 2FA". Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) and enter the confirmation code.

howToEditProfile.q: How do I edit my profile?
howToEditProfile.a: On the "Profile" page, click "Edit Profile". You can change your name, patronymic, bio, specialty, and social media links.

howToManageMembers.q: How do I manage organization members?
howToManageMembers.a: In the admin panel on the "Organization" tab, you can view the member list, change roles, and manage access. Available roles: member, manager, and administrator.

whatArePrivacyRules.a: Privacy rules let you configure what data is collected and processed. Administrators can create rules by data type, match pattern, and action (allow, block, mask).

howToApproveRequests.q: How do I approve join requests?
howToApproveRequests.a: In the admin panel on the "Organization" tab, incoming requests are displayed. Click "Approve" to accept or "Reject" to decline. Approved users immediately gain access to the organization.

howToContactSupport.a: Go to the "Support" section via the sidebar menu. Create a new chat, enter the subject and describe your issue. You can also attach screenshots. An administrator will reply in the same chat.

howLongForReply.q: How long until I get a support reply?
howLongForReply.a: Typically a response comes within a business day. Your request status is shown in the chat list: "Open" — awaiting response, "Answered" — response received, "Closed" — issue resolved.
